recordType.title: Record type
recordType.description: page and chunk rows are charged; document rows are free summaries (in document mode the document row carries the content and is charged by page count).

url.title: URL
url.description: The PDF URL exactly as you supplied it.

documentId.title: Document ID
documentId.description: First 16 hex chars of the SHA-256 of the downloaded bytes. Identical files share it; use it to dedupe.

pageCount.title: Page count
pageCount.description: Total pages in the PDF, before pageRange and caps.

text.title: Text
text.description: Plain text of the page, document or chunk. Line breaks normalised to \n, Unicode NFC. Empty for image-only pages when ocr is off.
text.example: Request for Taxpayer Identification Number and Certification

markdown.title: Markdown
markdown.description: Heuristic markdown: headings from font-size rank, paragraphs from line gaps, ruled tables as GitHub tables. Null when includeMarkdown is off or the row was trimmed (item_too_large).
markdown.example:
# Form W-9

Request for Taxpayer Identification Number and Certification

tables.title: Tables
tables.description: Page rows: ruled tables as arrays of rows of cell strings. Document rows: [{page, rows}]. Null when extractTables is off or nothing was found.

tableCount.title: Table count
tableCount.description: Number of ruled tables found on the page.

width.title: Width (pt)
width.description: Page width in PDF points (1/72 inch).

hasTextLayer.title: Has text layer
hasTextLayer.description: True when the page has at least 20 text characters before OCR.

ocrApplied.title: OCR applied
ocrApplied.description: True when the text came from Tesseract (charged as ocr-page).

needsOcr.title: Needs OCR
needsOcr.description: True for an image-only page that was not OCRed (ocr off, or maxOcrPagesPerPdf reached). Delivered empty and free.

chunkIndex.title: Chunk index
chunkIndex.description: 0-based index of the chunk within its document (chunk rows).

chunkCount.title: Chunk count
chunkCount.description: Number of chunks the document produced.

charStart.title: Start offset
charStart.description: Character offset of the chunk in the concatenated document text.

charEnd.title: End offset
charEnd.description: Character offset just past the chunk's last character.

headingPath.title: Heading path
headingPath.description: Nearest markdown headings above the chunk start, outermost first.

fileName.title: File name
fileName.description: From Content-Disposition or the URL path.

status.title: Status
status.description: ok = every selected page delivered; partial = some pages skipped (pages_capped, budget_exhausted, item_too_large); error = nothing delivered.

errorCode.title: Error code
errorCode.description: Why a document is partial or failed: blocked_url, download_failed, too_large, not_pdf, password_required, permissions_restricted, malformed, timeout, pages_capped, budget_exhausted, run_timeout, item_too_large, duplicate. Null when ok.

httpStatus.title: HTTP status
httpStatus.description: Status of the final response, or null when no response was received.

contentType.title: Content-Type
contentType.description: Content-Type header of the final response.

pagesExtracted.title: Pages extracted
pagesExtracted.description: Pages delivered for this document (rows, chunks covered or pages array).

pagesCharged.title: Pages charged
pagesCharged.description: page events charged for this document (page and chunk mode: what was actually charged; document mode: the count requested by the charge that follows the push). 0 on free runs.

ocrPagesCharged.title: OCR pages charged
ocrPagesCharged.description: ocr-page events charged for this document.

imageOnlyPages.title: Image-only pages
imageOnlyPages.description: Pages with no text layer and at least one image (OCR candidates).

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: PDF info dictionary: title, author, subject, keywords, creator, producer, creationDate, modificationDate (ISO 8601 or null), pdfVersion.

encrypted.title: Encrypted
encrypted.description: True when the file uses PDF encryption (opened with pdfPassword or an empty user password).

permissionsCopyAllowed.title: Copying allowed
permissionsCopyAllowed.description: False when the owner disabled text copying; such files are always skipped with permissions_restricted.

pages.title: Pages
pages.description: Document mode only: [{page, text, charCount, ocrApplied}]. text is dropped when the row exceeds 8 MB (item_too_large).

durationMs.title: Duration (ms)
durationMs.description: Download plus parse time for the document.

fetchedAt.title: Fetched at
fetchedAt.description: UTC time the document was fetched (document rows only; charged rows carry no timestamp).

pages.title: Pages
pages.description: One line per charged page row.

documents.title: Documents
documents.description: One free summary row per URL with status and error code.
